pieces.name: Grand Archivist Mold
pieces.note: Grand Archivist Mold: a floating bookshelf wizard with a spore-cloud head. Fights with an OVERDUE rubber stamp and a dripping quill.

pieces.name: Dowser Dave
pieces.note: Dowser Dave, the Inflatable Prophet: a wacky waving tube man on a leaf blower. Flails a pennant whip and points a dowsing rod.

pieces.name: Count Glitterfang
pieces.note: Count Glitterfang the Brooding: a very pale, very sparkly vampire. Wields a rhinestone baseball bat and a cape of bats.

pieces.name: The Haggler
pieces.note: The Haggler: a six-armed folding-table merchant with a megaphone beard. Every arm holds a bargain. NO REFUNDS.

pieces.name: The Lunch Lady Colossus
pieces.note: The Lunch Lady Colossus: a huge cafeteria lunch lady rising from a steam table. Swings a giant ladle of glowing gravy and serves mystery meat that fights back.

pieces.name: Mimic Queen
pieces.note: A treasure chest wearing a crown, with too many teeth and a tongue she uses as a flail. Wields a scepter and a sack of coins.

pieces.name: Pep Rally, Incarnate
pieces.note: Pep Rally, Incarnate: a mascot wombat fused with an entire cheer squad. Swings a giant foam finger and a megaphone cannon.

pieces.name: Principal Fogwhistle
pieces.note: Principal Fogwhistle: a spindly principal whose mouth is a PA horn. Announces attacks over the intercom. Carries a yardstick lance and a detention-slip clipboard.

pieces.name: Big Raccoon Energy
pieces.note: Big Raccoon Energy: three raccoons in one trench coat, stacked three stories high. The one on top is in charge.

pieces.name: Tiny mimic queen
pieces.note: A tiny mimic queen: a chest the size of a footstool in a crown, snapping at ankles.
